messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: spike in SSE disconnects for /v1/stream (prod, us-west-2). Error rate baseline 0.3% -> 8.9% starting 2026-03-15T09:12:34Z. Paging #eng-sre-oncall.

emma (eng-sre): taking this. Runtime + platform, plz join. Any customer-facing impacts known? @jordan

jordan (support): we have multiple support tickets from customers using function-calls over streaming — reported reconnect loops and truncated tool responses. Example ticket: https://redwoodcs.example/t/67890

mike (eng-runtime): infra metrics show sudden increase in parse_error events with tool_payload_incomplete. Also see L7 proxy RST_STREAM logs co-timed. Collecting logs, dumping traces now.

sofia (eng-ml): seeing function-call JSONs truncated mid-object on some streams. Quick mitigation: make the parser tolerant of a final partial event for 3s to allow reconnect reassembly. I'll prep a canary patch.

rui (eng-platform): pulled proxy excerpts: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:33.900Z proxy[lb-a] INFO stream_id=xyz123 idle=19.9s close=timeout reason=STREAM_IDLE
2026-03-15T09:12:34.001Z proxy[lb-a] INFO http2 RST_STREAM code=8 stream=xyz123 remote=10.1.4.11
2026-03-15T09:12:34.012Z runtime[worker-7] WARN parse_error stream=xyz123 tool=lookup args_incomplete=1
```
Looks like idle enforcement. Current envoy settings: `stream_idle_timeout=20s`, `http2_keepalive_interval=20s`.

mike (eng-runtime): if LB is cutting streams at 20s and some SDKs dont send ping frames, that'll explain the RSTs. But also need to confirm whether clients are sending pings. Rui can you sample client UA and connection ages?

rui (eng-platform): sampling failed streams: 
```
- 10.1.4.11 age=14s ua=sdk-js/1.0.3
- 10.1.4.55 age=81s ua=sdk-go/0.5.2
- 10.1.4.99 age=7s ua=sdk-python/0.9.5
```
Notably older sdk-js 1.0.3 shows up a lot.

jordan (support): noted. CSMs are already on the largest impacted accounts; recommending immediate fallback to non-streaming for live demos. Paul can confirm.

paul (customer-success): for the demo org I've toggled streaming->polling at 09:25Z. Demo resumed without errors. They prefer reliability even with extra latency.

emma (eng-sre): mitigation plan (short-term): 1) bump stream_idle_timeout to 60s on LB canary, 2) deploy parser leniency on a single runtime canary worker, 3) support toggle per-org to non-streaming. If no improvement, perform rolling restart of LB.

incident-bot: deploy-event recorded: 2026-03-15T09:17:02Z rui -> lb-canary config update

rui (eng-platform): rolling LB canary now (10% traffic) with `stream_idle_timeout=60s`. Watching metrics.

emma (eng-sre): canary error rate dropped from 8.9% -> 1.2% within 5m. Prod baseline still ~8.6%.

mike (eng-runtime): parser change pushed to worker-7 canary. It buffers a partial last event up to 3s and expects client recon to complete framing. Deployed, watching parse_error metric.

sofia (eng-ml): we'll still need to reproduce split-frame tool-call payloads in a harness to be sure we won't mask real data corruption. I'll set that up.

rui (eng-platform): extra data dump: sample raw SSE frames around failure: 
```
:data: {"id":"e123","tool_call":{"name":"query","args":\n:data: "{\"sql\":\"SELECT * FROM orders WHERE id=\""\n:event: EOF
```
This shows JSON split across SSE events — if the connection is aborted that results in incomplete payload.

mike (eng-runtime): thanks. That matches parse error entries. Hypotheses for RCA: 
- H1: LB idle/ping policy too aggressive -> server RST_STREAM when clients don't send keepalives. 
- H2: Older SDKs don't emit application-level pings -> exposed by idle logic.
- H3: Runtime parser lacks reassembly for split SSE frames leading to tool-call failures even after reconnect.

sofia (eng-ml): I'll attempt to reproduce with sdk-js/1.0.3 in network emulator that injects abrupt drops and reordered frames.

emma (eng-sre): actions and owners (short):
- rui: LB config rollout to prod and add counter for stream_close_reason (client/server/timeout). ETA 24h.
- mike + sofia: durable parser reassembly, test harness for split-frame function-calls, and unit tests for tool-call atomicity. ETA 48h.
- jordan + paul: CS comms + org-level streaming toggle + SDK upgrade guidance. ETA 12h.
- emma: incident timeline + postmortem doc. ETA 48h.

jordan (support): adding note to customer ticket explaining fallback, ETA for permanent fix, and recommending immediate SDK upgrade where possible.

paul (customer-success): scheduling follow-up with affected customers tomorrow. We should offer migration help to any still on sdk-js/1.0.x.

mike (eng-runtime): long-term design notes: consider a reassembly layer in proxy that ensures each SSE event contains a single complete JSON doc (or uses length-prefixed frames), or add server-originated pings so LB considers streams active.

sofia (eng-ml): will run 1k-session load test with canary config and parser changes to validate for 48h.

emma (eng-sre): marking incident mitigated for now — streaming fallback used for critical customers, canary fixes show improvement. Keeping thread open for RCA artifacts and logs. Severity set to SEV-2.

incident-bot: incident status -> mitigated at 2026-03-15T09:29:12Z. Assigned: emma (eng-sre)

emma (eng-sre): I'll compile timeline, attach logs (proxy + runtime + sample frames), and draft the postmortem. Let's reconvene tomorrow for RCA review. Thanks all. :slightly_smiling_face:
